prompts.markerOpenPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art world-map quest marker, OPEN state.
Reference image 1 is the original marker design to homage: an irregular jagged burst / speech balloon containing three exclamation marks !!!. Reference image 2 is the approved game map, solely for art direction.
Create ONE small, polished game UI sprite. Preserve the distinctive broad jagged speech-burst silhouette and precisely three exclamation marks. Redesign with pale ivory parchment-white filling, restrained navy-violet outline, a fine warm gold inner edge, and bright amber-gold exclamation marks with a warm ruby shadow. Refined pixel clusters, crisp silhouette, legible when downscaled to 56px. Fantasy star-lit RPG tone, matching the map's warm gold architecture and deep blue palette. Keep ornamental detail minimal; do not turn this into a crest, shield, medallion or star. No wings or leaves.
Composition: single centered compact icon with generous even transparent margin. True transparent background, no scene, no checkerboard, no labels except !!!, no other text. No ground shadow, no large glow.
prompts.markerClosedPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art world-map quest marker, LOCKED state.
Edit target image 1 is the new approved-for-preview OPEN marker. Reference image 2 is the original closed marker to homage.
Keep image 1's jagged ivory burst silhouette, navy outline, gold edge, three gold !!! marks and exact pixel style/size/proportions unchanged. Add a clear crossed X of dark blue-gray iron chains running from the four corners and a small ornate closed padlock in front at the intersection, exactly the visual language of reference image 2. The lock has a simple visible keyhole; a little muted antique-gold trim connects it with the fantasy art direction. The three exclamation marks remain recognizable behind the chains. Clean readable pixel clusters at 56px, not fine noisy jewelry.
Single centered sprite at the same scale with same padding as image 1, genuine transparent background. No checkerboard, backdrop, text labels, scene, or large glow.
prompts.buildingLayerPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: registered transparent foreground layer for a world-map hover animation.
Edit target: the supplied approved 1672 x 941 game world map.
Extract ONLY its six landmark complexes into one transparent full-map layer. Preserve their EXACT designs, sizes, image coordinates, camera angle, colors, texture and placement. Do not redesign or rearrange them and do not add details. Preserve the canvas aspect ratio 1672:941. This is a cutout of the same source pixels, not a sheet of new concepts.
Keep: upper-left golden cathedral with its floating rock island; middle-left blue-roof castle and immediate castle walls/entrance steps; center blue-roof fortified town with its perimeter walls; middle-right Gothic graveyard chapel, gravestones and enclosing low wall; bottom-left sea ruin arches, columns and their immediate stone platform; upper-right volcanic gate with its flanking ruin columns and immediate gate platform.
Remove ALL other scenery to genuine alpha transparency: sky, clouds not part of floating island, sea, mountains, forests, roads, general ground, rivers, lava, and surrounding trees. Foreground complexes have tight organic edges following the architecture and immediate foundations, with no rectangular tiles. Leave every kept complex at EXACTLY its original position, not enlarged or relocated. No added cast shadows, labels, UI, numbers or frame.
prompts.mapCleanPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: clean background plate for the supplied RPG world map.
Edit target image 1 is the approved world map. Image 2 shows exactly the six foreground landmark complexes that need to be REMOVED from image 1.
Remove those six complexes and reconstruct only the natural scenery directly behind them. This includes: golden floating shrine and its rock island at upper-left (replace with existing surrounding sky clouds and distant snowy mountains); blue-roof castle at mid-left (forest clearing and path); central fortified village (empty grassy clearing with connecting dirt paths); right Gothic chapel, graves and enclosing walls (misty empty woodland clearing and path); bottom-left sea arches/columns/platforms (shallow turquoise water and rocky shoreline); upper-right volcanic gate/columns (bare volcanic stone and existing lava light).
Keep ALL other pixels/composition as close to input as possible: entire island silhouette, rivers, bridges, mountains, volcano, forests, paths, ocean, clouds, camera, lighting, texture, palette, original 1672:941 aspect ratio and landmark coordinates. Do not create new buildings, objects, roads or landmarks. Do not shift or rescale the map. Natural small local seamless inpainting only, preserving the approved map illustration style. No text, labels, UI or border.
